in_marathi.name: Dillip
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dillip हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dillip is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhi' meaning 'intelligence' and 'lip' meaning 'shining' or 'brilliant'. It is a name given to a child who is believed to be intelligent and bright, just like the sun.
